mapper.insert: INSERT INTO token_reservation(invocation_id, tenant_id, user_id, quota_date, estimated_input_tokens, reserved_tokens, max_output_tokens, model_id, model_name, session_id, run_id, state, charged_tokens, expires_at) VALUES(#{ticket.invocationId}, #{ticket.tenantId}, #{ticket.userId}, #{ticket.quotaDate}, #{ticket.estimatedInputTokens}, #{ticket.reservedTokens}, #{ticket.maxOutputTokens}, #{ticket.modelId}, #{ticket.modelName}, #{ticket.sessionId}, #{ticket.runId}, 'PENDING', 0, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{ttlSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
mapper.sql: invocation_id, tenant_id, user_id, quota_date, estimated_input_tokens, reserved_tokens, max_output_tokens, model_id, model_name, session_id, run_id, state, charged_tokens
mapper.select: SELECT FROM token_reservation WHERE invocation_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

UPDATE token_daily_quota SET charged_tokens = charged_tokens + #{chargedDelta}, reserved_tokens = reserved_tokens + #{reservedDelta}, uncertain_tokens = uncertain_tokens + #{uncertainDelta}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND user_id = #{user} AND quota_date = #{day} AND charged_tokens + #{chargedDelta} >= 0 AND reserved_tokens + #{reservedDelta} >= 0 AND uncertain_tokens + #{uncertainDelta} >= 0
